Shatavari Powder Supplier India: Discover Shatavari Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Looking for a shatavari powder supplier in India? Tradenest Naturals fine mills dried shatavari roots (Asparagus racemosus) into an even, cream-coloured powder. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. As an ayurvedic herbs exporter india, we supply supplement and herbal brands in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. Shatavari is traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations, and we keep each lot consistent.

Quality and Specifications

We keep our specifications clear and simple. Our shatavari powder 100 mesh grade is milled to 80-100 mesh for smooth blending. Our pure shatavari powder bulk supply is plain root powder with nothing added. We fine mill and sieve the dried roots, then pack them promptly to keep them dry.
  • Composition: plain shatavari root, no additives.
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh, fine milled.
  • Moisture Content: at or below 7%.
  • Documents: specification sheet with every quotation; third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Flexible Wholesale and Private Label Solutions

Do you need a shatavari powder bulk supplier for your brand? We offer custom packing and OEM private label services. Our shatavari root powder wholesale program has clear pricing by volume. This helps businesses of all sizes plan their buying.
  • What is the minimum order quantity for shatavari powder from India? Our MOQ is 5 Kg, which suits trial batches and repeat orders.
  • What certifications and quality standards apply? We are an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter.
  • What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We pack in moisture-barrier bags, and the shelf life is 24 months.

Applications in Supplements and Ayurveda

Shatavari powder goes into Ayurvedic churna blends, capsules and dietary supplements. Formulators who ask about spray dried shatavari powder often use our fine milled grade in beverage mixes. The shatavari powder price per kg is quoted for your volume and packing. Contact Tradenest Naturals to request a sample or quote.
